question: Should this PR's curated OpenRouter current-image-model list route those stable/current IDs through `/api/v1/images` now, preserving old preview IDs on chat completions, after a current-main rebase?
rationale: This is a provider policy and upgrade-safety choice: it improves current model support, but can change endpoint behavior for manually configured model IDs and overlaps separate stable-Gemini work.

options.title: Accept Curated Images API Routing
options.body: Rebase the branch, preserve current-main capability helpers, and land the provider-local curated `/images` route with the existing no-paid runtime proof plus CI.

options.title: Narrow To Proven IDs
options.body: Reduce the curated list to the IDs maintainers want to support immediately and leave the broader catalog policy in the linked feature request.

options.title: Defer Behind Catalog Policy
options.body: Keep this PR paused while maintainers decide dynamic OpenRouter image discovery or the stable-Gemini/default policy first.

recommendation.title: Accept Curated Images API Routing
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, preserve current-main capability helpers, and land the provider-local curated `/images` route with the existing no-paid runtime proof plus CI.
